description: Deliver a two-file radio observatory coverage audit. Input x has 'window':[lo,hi], 'quorum' (positive integer) and 'records':[[instrument,start,end],...]. Records are half-open intervals, may repeat or overlap for the same instrument, and may extend beyond the window. Count DISTINCT instruments observing at the same time after clipping to [lo,hi). Produce every maximal interval where the count is at least quorum. Merge touching qualified spans even when the participating instruments change. Discard empty intervals. Return a dict mapping 'coverage.csv' and 'audit.json' to their file texts. CSV starts start,end with a final newline; rows sorted by start. Audit JSON must have keys 'covered' (total qualifying length) and 'longest' ([start,end] of the longest qualifying interval, earliest on ties, or null). Up to 60,000 records; coordinates can be trillions apart. Do not iterate over the time axis.
provenance: Learned interval union, fitted event-sweep family and a model-written file renderer.
